method: Phase-local detection on standardized geometry at each phase median human chord; includes 5cm residual normalization floor. Human diagnostic source is the dense globally 5mm-smoothed path; fitting uses its 25-point compressed shape library. Both populations receive identical additional detector smoothing. This is not the earlier full-trajectory attributed bend analysis. LOO is optimistic oracle projection, not prediction. Physical execution constraints further modify curves.
